newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips end lower despite surge by IBM.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips end lower despite surge by IBM.

text.p: U.S. blue chips ended lower on Thursday, unable to catch fire amid an eight percent surge by International Business Machines Corp.
The Dow finished off about 20 points, or 0.3 percent, at 6792.
IBM leaped 11-5/8 to 154 after posting first-quarter profits late Wednesday that beat Wall Street expectations.
But lackluster earnings elsewhere and general investor caution weighed on the market, traders and analysts said.
But traders and analysts said that Thursday's action was an indication the rebound might be running out of steam.
"There's a lot of investors who believe this rally is going to fizzle very quickly," said Guy Truicko, equity portfolio manager at Unity Management.
In fact, the Dow raced up 78 points in early trading Thursday before fading.
Market players said they expected caution to prevail into next week, when Wall Street will fix on economic data that could indicate the near-term course of U.S. interest rates.
